programme.displayName: Amazon SQS: Basic Message Queue Test
programme.subtitle: Create and test a standard queue with one harmless message
programme.description: A short beginner programme for using Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) to create a standard queue, send one test message, receive it, and delete the received message.
programme.learningOutcome: Build and test a basic message queue safely

phases.title: Prepare
phases.description: Confirm the intended scope, permissions, and safe test-data approach.

phases.title: Create
phases.description: Create a basic Amazon SQS standard queue.

phases.title: Send
phases.description: Place one harmless test message on the queue.

phases.title: Receive and verify
phases.description: Receive the test message and confirm the queue behaviour.

phases.title: Complete the test
phases.description: Delete the received test message and review queue lifecycle implications.

tasks.title: Confirm safe scope and required access
tasks.goal: Use a non-confidential queue name and confirm that the required SQS actions are available before starting.
tasks.whyItMatters: Queue names should not contain PII or other confidential information, and the learner needs authorization for the planned operations.

consoleSteps.title: Set the Region

instructions.text: Select eu-west-2 in the Console Region selector.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: eu-west-2 is the selected Console Region.

consoleSteps.title: Choose safe test data

instructions.text: Choose the non-confidential queue name sqs-beginner-test.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: A harmless queue name is ready to use.
consoleSteps.warning: Do not include PII or confidential information in the queue name.

consoleSteps.title: Confirm existing access

instructions.text: Confirm your signed-in account or role already has required SQS Console access.
instructions.detail: Do not create, attach, recommend, or edit an IAM policy.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: You are ready to use the SQS Console with access already granted by an administrator.

verification.title: Verify the queue name is non-confidential
verification.instruction: Inspect the chosen queue name before creating the queue.
verification.expectedResult: The name is sqs-beginner-test and contains no sensitive information.

Choosing your Region - AWS Management Console

tasks.title: Create a standard queue
tasks.goal: Create one basic standard SQS queue for the test.
tasks.whyItMatters: The queue provides the destination for the test message and keeps the exercise focused on the standard-queue workflow.

consoleSteps.title: Create the queue
consoleSteps.expectedResult: Amazon SQS displays the new queue’s Details page.

verification.title: Verify queue creation
verification.instruction: Inspect the page displayed after creating the queue.
verification.expectedResult: The Details page for sqs-beginner-test is displayed.

officialAwsReferences.title: Creating an Amazon SQS standard queue and sending a message - Amazon Simple Queue Service

tasks.title: Send one harmless test message
tasks.goal: Send a single non-confidential test message to the new queue.
tasks.whyItMatters: A single harmless message gives the learner a controlled item to receive and handle.

consoleSteps.title: Send the test message

instructions.text: Choose Actions, then Send and receive messages.
Enter `Hello from an SQS test` in Message body.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: The console displays a success message.

verification.title: Verify message submission
verification.instruction: Inspect the confirmation shown after sending the message.
verification.expectedResult: The Console displays a message-sent success confirmation.

officialAwsReferences.title: Creating an Amazon SQS standard queue and sending a message - Amazon Simple Queue Service

tasks.title: Receive and inspect the test message
tasks.goal: Poll the queue, receive the harmless test message, and inspect its details in the Console.
tasks.whyItMatters: Receiving a message does not automatically delete it; the receipt handle is required to complete the test safely.

consoleSteps.title: Receive the test message

instructions.text: Select the harmless test message in Messages.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: The Messages section shows the received test message with its Message ID, Sent date, Size, and Receive count.

verification.title: Verify the received message
verification.instruction: Inspect the Messages section after polling.
verification.expectedResult: The received test message shows a Message ID, Sent date, Size, and Receive count.

officialAwsReferences.title: Receiving and deleting a message in Amazon SQS - Amazon Simple Queue Service

tasks.title: Delete the received test message
tasks.goal: Select and delete the received harmless test message in the Console.
tasks.whyItMatters: Deleting the message prevents it from being received again and completes the basic message-handling test.

consoleSteps.title: Delete the test message

instructions.text: Select the retrieved harmless test message.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: The selected test message is deleted from the queue.
consoleSteps.warning: Messages are not deleted automatically after retrieval.

verification.title: Verify deletion confirmation
verification.instruction: Inspect the Messages section after confirming deletion.
verification.expectedResult: The selected test message is no longer shown.

officialAwsReferences.title: Receiving and deleting a message in Amazon SQS - Amazon Simple Queue Service

tasks.title: Review queue deletion effects
tasks.goal: Understand the permanent effects and timing considerations of deleting an SQS queue after a test.
tasks.whyItMatters: Queue deletion permanently removes its messages and has timing considerations for recreating a queue with the same name.

consoleSteps.title: Review lifecycle effects

instructions.text: Acknowledge that deleting a queue removes its messages.
Acknowledge that the temporary queue will be removed during Stage 8.

consoleSteps.expectedResult: You understand that queue deletion is permanent for the queue’s messages and is deferred to Stage 8.
consoleSteps.warning: Do not delete the queue in Stage 6.

verification.title: Verify lifecycle understanding
verification.expectedResult: It states that a queue can be deleted even when it is not empty.

officialAwsReferences.title: Deleting an Amazon SQS queue - Amazon Simple Queue Service

cleanup.title: Open the target queue
cleanup.instruction: In the Amazon SQS console, choose Queues and select sqs-beginner-test only.
cleanup.verification: Confirm sqs-beginner-test is the selected queue; do not select messages, other queues, or other AWS resources.

cleanup.title: Delete the approved queue
cleanup.instruction: With sqs-beginner-test selected, choose Delete, enter delete in the confirmation dialog, then choose Delete.
cleanup.verification: Confirm the deletion action was submitted for sqs-beginner-test only.

cleanup.title: Refresh and verify removal
cleanup.instruction: Return to the Queues list and refresh it after deleting sqs-beginner-test.
cleanup.verification: Visibly confirm that sqs-beginner-test is no longer listed.

warnings.credentials: Never save AWS secrets or private keys.
